title: Pwnagotchi
summary: Pwnagotchi dashboard and controls with external monitor-mode USB Wi-Fi.
description:
Pwnagotchi brings local pwnagotchi and bettercap status to CardputerZero in an APPLaunch-ready dashboard. It provides Home, Stats, and Control pages together with Start, Stop, Restart, Manual, and Auto actions.

The CardputerZero CM0 onboard Wi-Fi does not support monitor mode and cannot be used for packet capture. This app requires an external monitor-mode capable USB Wi-Fi adapter. Tested hardware: TP-Link TL-WN722N v1.0 with the Atheros AR9271 chipset. Use only on networks and devices you own or are authorized to test.
